subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The code path is focused and covered, but it deliberately changes which transcript rows can drive visible A2A replies, and green CI cannot prove every live channel history shape.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message failure and leaves reverse-send and compaction issues to separate fixes.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Plan
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, requester return-path, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated as one delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message failure and leaves reverse-send and compaction issues to separate fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the closest recent history on delivery-mirror transcript artifact identity and adjacent QA coverage.
